commentary_title: VLCC freight rates to remain elevated
commentary_summary: The escalation of conflict in the Middle East has brought new geopolitical upheavals in the tanker market. While the VLCC market was soft for most of week 24, the Israel-Iran conflict resulted in a sudden uptick in tanker rates towards the end of the week. As the Strait of Hormuz is a hub for VLCC trade, freight rates will likely remain heightened as long as the conflict persists. | Meanwhile, vessels might avoid the region due to increased risks caused by the conflict. In the short term, this could cause more vessels to ballast towards other regions, resulting in higher tonne-miles covered.
